cell_admission.authority: The frozen r8_harness.py render command is the closed-world cell authority.
cell_admission.storage_rule: Renderer stdout is UTF-8 with exactly one terminal LF; the LF is storage-only and excluded from provider-visible payload identity.

dispatch_invariants.concurrency_policy: External controller must pace invocations; this adapter starts and cleanly stops one app-server and performs no fanout.

controller_invalid_semantics.subject_call_started_false_meaning: No turn/start request was sent; exact recreation may be considered only by the external frozen-run controller.
controller_invalid_semantics.subject_call_started_true_meaning: A turn/start request was sent, so this adapter never authorizes recreation or replacement.

provider_identity_limitation: Requested route, openai provider, turn-context model/effort, and pm-dev thread/turn are attestable; a separate provider-effective serving snapshot is not exposed.
non_claims: This disposable controller is not production infrastructure.
A controller-valid receipt is not a semantic PASS.
Static validation is not subject execution or qualification evidence.
